// Package unformatted holds the shapes gofmt would rewrite, which the original still judges: parentheses around the
// loop's condition and doubled ones, a body of one line, and an empty statement after the store.
package unformatted

func loops(values []int, n int, offset int) {
	for i := 0; (i < n); i++ {
		values[i] = values[offset+i]
	}
	for i := ((0)); ((i)) < ((n)); ((i))++ {
		((values))[((i))] = ((values))[((offset))+((i))]
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ { values[i] = values[offset+i] }
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ { { values[i] = values[offset+i] } }
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		values[i] = values[offset+i];
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		values[i] = values[offset+i];;
	}
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		{ values[i] = values[offset+i]; };
	}
}
